focus: This function feeds the weekly re-engagement email campaign: we only want to email users who have actually used the product recently, not everyone whose account is nominally active. Each user record includes a last_login_at timestamp field, but note that status is set once at signup and is never updated afterward -- a user who signed up two years ago and never returned still has status active. Check whether this function actually implements active in the last 30 days as the campaign needs, or just checks the signup-time status flag.
